verdict.rationale: Tailscale documents a mesh overlay network that connects devices across clouds and on-prem without port forwarding or public IPs (docs-5, docs-33). Users report SSH-ing straight into home and remote boxes (comm-1, comm-13). However, Tailscale is itself a VPN overlay, and a hands-on report notes NAT traversal sometimes falls back to DERP relays, which limits speed (comm-11). New connections also depend on reaching Tailscale's control ports (comm-15), so the 'no relay, no VPN' framing is only partly met. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of direct peer-to-peer connection paths, guaranteed relay-free connectivity, and operation without a VPN layer or control-plane dependency.
